item.title: Your Agent's Shell Allowlist Is Bypassable
item.description:
Every shipmates crew member runs shell commands. Before any of them runs, it goes through a permission gate. The gate uses the same rule syntax as Claude Code settings: Bash(git status), Bash(rm *), Write(**/.claude/settings.json). The rules are merged from several layers:

  • a fleet-wide deny list pushed from Fleet Command
  • per-persona policy files
  • project settings
  • the Brig, which compiles shipmates’ fifteen “Ship’s Articles” into deny and ask rules

Deny beats ask, ask beats allow.
